Kim — attaching the first draft of the materials. Highlights below and notes for redaction:

Attached: admin_role_matrix.xlsx, scim_sync_playbook.pdf, redwood_scim_mapping.csv

- Admin role matrix: includes Org Admin, Billing Admin, Security Admin, Project Admin, Service Owner. Each role shows explicit capabilities and whether the role can delegate specific rights (yes/no) with examples.
- SCIM playbook: step-by-step for initial bulk import (CSV -> validate -> delta reconciliation), delta cadence typically every 5-15 minutes for enterprise customers, conflict strategy is "last-writer wins" with configurable attribute precedence, automatic retry for transient errors up to 6 attempts with exponential backoff.
- SCIM mapping CSV: shows attribute mapping for common IdPs; note that we support both SCIM 1.1 and 2.0 semantics and can adjust attribute mappings per customer.

Open items: audit log redact sample and retention excerpt (Neha), plus SOC2 excerpt which legal prefers on a secure link rather than email.

Let me know if you want tighter language for the RFP.

Marissa

[Attachments: admin_role_matrix.xlsx (Excel), scim_sync_playbook.pdf (PDF), redwood_scim_mapping.csv (CSV)]

Adding audit log excerpt and evidence notes.

Attached: audit_log_retention_excerpt.pdf, logs_sample.json, access_controls_diagram.png

Key points to include in the cover packet:
- Retention: Auth-related events (login, token_issued, token_revoked, user_create, user_disable, role_change) are retained in searchable stores for 365 days by default; raw write-ahead logs retained for 90 days. Retention can be extended under enterprise contracts and is subject to customer region/data residency controls.
- Auditability: All admin actions are immutably logged with actor, timestamp, origin IP, session id, and the pre/post state where applicable. Logs are tamper-evident (append-only logging + SHA-256 chaining) and integrated with our SIEM exports.
- Access to raw logs and SOC2 artifacts: we require a signed NDA and a secure artifact transfer (DocuSign/ShareFile) for full reports. Redacted excerpts and parsed samples are safe to share.

Notes on delegated admin: our platform supports hierarchical delegation: org-level Admins can delegate Project Admin roles; Project Admins can create Service Owners but cannot escalate to Org Admin. Service Owners can provision service accounts scoped to their service. The admin_role_matrix includes this mapping and examples.

Neha

[Attachments: audit_log_retention_excerpt.pdf (PDF), logs_sample.json (JSON, redacted), access_controls_diagram.png (PNG)]
